text: The Japanese yen traded at 162.19 per U.S. dollar, its weakest level since 1986. Japanese officials stated they remained prepared to intervene in foreign exchange markets if necessary. Government bond yields at the long end increased while the exchange rate established a new multi-decade low.

meta.note: Official intervention remained conditional and was not activated within this event.

text: Abivax released supplemental Phase 3 clinical data for obefazimod, including additional safety and remission results. The company stated it remains on track for a planned U.S. regulatory submission later in 2026. Its shares rose approximately 34% following the disclosure after a sharp decline earlier in the month.

meta.note: The share-price movement and clinical data are logged as a single disclosure event without classifying acquisition speculation.
